# SQL Patterns: mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live

## Common WHERE Filters

- `grass_date = date('YYYY-MM-DD')` — 单日分区过滤（最常用）
- `grass_date between date('YYYY-MM-DD') and date('YYYY-MM-DD')` — 日期范围
- `grass_date >= trunc('${grass_date}','MM')` — MTD（月初至今）
- `grass_date >= add_months(${biz_date}, -3)` — 最近 N 月滑动窗口
- `tz_type = 'regional'` — 区域时区（take rate 分析、大盘报告最常用，~70%）
- `tz_type = 'local'` — 本地时区（ROI3 voucher、Live Ads 分析）
- `grass_region = upper('${region}')` / `'SG'` / `'ID'` — 单地区
- `grass_region in ('ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN','BR')` — 全地区
- `pricing_type = 18` — ROI3 产品类型过滤
- `pricing_type in (9, 10, 14)` — Live Ads 产品类型
- `entry_point in ('Livestream Discovery', 'Livestream For You', ...)` — 直播入口过滤

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- JOIN with campaign-level performance — 广告诊断场景
FROM take_rate_agg tr
JOIN raw_overall_data
  ON tr.grass_date = raw_overall_data.grass_date
 AND tr.grass_region = raw_overall_data.grass_region
 AND tr.entrance = raw_overall_data.entrance
 AND tr.pricing_type = raw_overall_data.pricing_type

-- JOIN with target2_perf_report (出价达成率)
FROM tr_info
LEFT JOIN cr_info
  ON tr_info.grass_date = cr_info.grass_date
 AND tr_info.grass_region = cr_info.grass_region

-- JOIN with ads_budget_supply_1d (预算供给)
FROM t1  -- take_rate 多维度 UNION ALL 聚合
LEFT JOIN t2  -- budget_supply 数据
  ON t1.grass_date = t2.grass_date
 AND t1.grass_region = t2.grass_region
 AND t1.traffic_type = t2.traffic_type
 AND t1.main_product_type = t2.main_product_type

-- JOIN with pricing_type_stats — ROI3 voucher 成本场景
FROM pricing_type_stats a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ... FROM take_rate_v2) b
  ON a.grass_date = b.grass_date
 AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
 AND a.pricing_type = b.pricing_type

-- SELF JOIN (revenue 按产品拆分 + platform GMV 去重)
FROM (... GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region, main_product_type) t1
LEFT JOIN (... sum(distinct platform_gmv) GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region) t2
  ON t1.grass_date = t2.grass_date
 AND t1.grass_region = t2.grass_region

-- MTD 同比分析 — 本月 vs 上月相同天数
LEFT OUTER JOIN old t2
  ON t1.entry_point = t2.entry_point
 AND t1.traffic_type = t2.traffic_type
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 基础收入指标
sum(ads_rev_usd) as gross_rev           -- 广告毛收入
sum(net_ads_rev_usd) as net_ads_rev     -- 净收入（扣退货退款）
sum(net_ads_rev_excl_sip_usd_1d) as net_ads_rev  -- 净收入（扣 SIP）

-- 去除 1P 卖家的净收入 (OKR 口径)
sum(case when seller_type_1p not in ('Local SCS', 'SCS', 'Lovito')
         then net_ads_rev_excl_sip_usd_1d end) as okr_net_rev

-- 券成本（注意聚合方式不同！）
sum(distinct ads_voucher_omni_platform_nmv_cost_usd) as platform_roi3_voucher_cost  -- 全维度只有一个总值，必须 DISTINCT
sum(ads_voucher_ads_nmv_cost_usd) as roi3_voucher_cost  -- 可按 entry_point/product_type 拆分

-- 平台指标（注意 distinct 去重，非累加字段）
sum(distinct platform_gmv) as platform_gmv
sum(distinct platform_gmv_excl_testorder) as platform_gmv
sum(distinct platform_imp) as platform_imp
sum(distinct entry_point_imp) as entry_point_imp

-- 广告效果指标
sum(ads_imp) as ads_imp
sum(ads_click) as ads_click
sum(ads_order) as ads_order
sum(ads_gmv_usd) as ads_gmv_usd

-- 广义订单指标（Broad Order）
sum(broad_order_gmv_usd) as broad_order_gmv_usd  -- 广义订单GMV（含非点击归因）
sum(broad_order_cnt) as broad_order_cnt          -- 广义订单数
```

```sql
    (grass_date, grass_region, entrance),                -- 单维 ALL
    (grass_date, grass_region, pricing_type),
    (grass_date, entrance, pricing_type),
    (grass_date, grass_region),                           -- 双维 ALL
    (grass_date, entrance),
    (grass_date, pricing_type),
    (grass_date)                                          -- 全 ALL
)
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: OKR Take Rate 日报（按 region）

```sql
-- Source: data_paidadsmart/manual_tasks/ljz/take_rate
SELECT
    grass_date, grass_region, tz_type
    ,SUM(ads_rev_usd) AS gross_ads_rev
    ,SUM(net_ads_rev_usd) AS net_ads_rev
    ,SUM(DISTINCT platform_gmv_excl_testorder) AS platform_gmv
    ,SUM(IF(seller_type_1p NOT IN ('Lovito','SCS','Local SCS'),
         net_ads_rev_excl_sip_usd_1d, 0)) AS okr_net_rev
    ,SUM(IF(seller_type_1p NOT IN ('Lovito','SCS','Local SCS'),
         net_ads_rev_excl_sip_usd_1d, 0))
     / SUM(DISTINCT platform_gmv_excl_testorder) AS okr_take_rate
    ,SUM(ads_rev_usd)
     / SUM(DISTINCT platform_gmv_excl_testorder) AS gross_take_rate
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date'2025-08-01' AND date'2025-08-25'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### Snippet 2: 效率指标拆解（CPM/CPC/CTR/CR/ROI）

```sql
-- Source: data_paidadsmart/manual_tasks/ljz/take_rate
SELECT
    grass_date, grass_region
    ,SUM(ads_rev_usd) / SUM(ads_imp) * 1000 AS cpm
    ,SUM(ads_rev_usd) / SUM(ads_click) AS cpc
    ,SUM(ads_click) * 1.0 / SUM(ads_imp) AS ctr
    ,SUM(ads_order) * 1.0 / SUM(ads_click) AS cr
    ,SUM(ads_gmv_usd) / SUM(ads_rev_usd) AS roi
    ,SUM(ads_imp) * 1.0 / SUM(DISTINCT entry_point_imp) AS ad_load
    ,SUM(DISTINCT entry_point_imp) * 1.0 / SUM(DISTINCT platform_imp) AS ep_traffic_ratio
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date'2025-08-20' AND tz_type = 'regional'
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### Snippet 3: 大盘表 — traffic_type 映射 + GROUPING SETS 汇总

```sql
-- Source: overall_table_v2_spark (ads_diagnosis)
WITH take_rate_data AS (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region
        ,CASE
            WHEN traffic_type = 'Video' THEN 'video'
            WHEN traffic_type = 'Livestream' THEN 'live'
            WHEN traffic_type = 'Search' THEN 'search'
            WHEN traffic_type = 'You May Also Like' THEN 'ymal'
            ELSE 'other'
        END AS entrance
        ,CAST(pricing_type AS STRING) AS pricing_type
        ,ads_rev_usd, net_ads_rev_usd, platform_gmv
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date('${ISO_YESTERDAY}') AND tz_type = 'regional'
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(grass_region, 'ALL') AS grass_region
    ,COALESCE(entrance, 'ALL') AS entrance
    ,SUM(ads_rev_usd) AS gross_rev_usd
    ,SUM(net_ads_rev_usd) AS net_ads_rev
    ,SUM(DISTINCT platform_gmv) AS platform_gmv
FROM take_rate_data
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (grass_date, grass_region, entrance, pricing_type),
    (grass_date, grass_region, entrance),
    (grass_date, grass_region),
    (grass_date)
)
```

### Snippet 4: MTD entry_point take rate 环比

```sql
-- Source: ads_entry_point_take_rate_contribution_mtd
SELECT
    CASE WHEN entry_point = 'Global Search' THEN 'Search'
         WHEN entry_point IN ('Daily Discover External','Daily Discover Mix Feed Internal') THEN 'DD'
         WHEN entry_point = 'You May Also Like' THEN 'YMAL'
         WHEN entry_point LIKE '%Video%' THEN 'Video'
         WHEN entry_point LIKE '%Livestream%' THEN 'Live'
         ELSE 'Undefined' END AS entry_point
    ,traffic_type
    ,SUM(ads_rev_usd) / SUM(DISTINCT platform_gmv) AS mtd_take_rate
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date >= trunc('${grass_date}','MM')
  AND grass_date <= date('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'regional' AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### Snippet 5: ROI3 voucher 成本拆分

```sql
-- Source: data_paidadsmart/scheduled_tasks/gmy/jimmy.lu/roi3_part2
-- 注意: ads_voucher_omni_platform_nmv_cost_usd 非累加，只能 MAX
```

### Snippet 6: 收入结构拆分（gross/net/1P/SIP/voucher）

```sql
-- Source: mkplpaidads_search_ads/manual_tasks/qianqian.pu/sop/oo
SELECT
    grass_date, grass_region
    ,SUM(ads_rev_usd) AS gross_rev
    ,SUM(net_ads_rev_usd) AS net_rev
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN seller_type_1p NOT IN ('Local SCS','SCS','Lovito')
              THEN net_ads_rev_usd END) AS net_rev_excl_1p
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN seller_type_1p NOT IN ('Local SCS','SCS','Lovito')
              THEN net_ads_rev_excl_sip_usd_1d END) AS net_rev_excl_1p_sip
    ,SUM(DISTINCT ads_voucher_omni_platform_nmv_cost_usd) AS platform_roi3_voucher
    ,SUM(ads_voucher_ads_nmv_cost_usd) AS roi3_voucher
    ,SUM(DISTINCT platform_gmv) AS platform_gmv
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date('2026-01-20') AND tz_type = 'regional' AND grass_region = 'SG'
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### Snippet 7: 按产品类型拆分净收入 + SELF JOIN platform GMV

```sql
-- Source: net_rev adhoc query
SELECT main_product_type, t1.grass_region, t1.grass_date
    ,AVG(platform_gmv) AS platform_gmv
    ,SUM(net_ads_rev_excl_1p) AS net_ads_rev_excl_1p
FROM (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region
        ,CASE
            WHEN entry_point IN ('Shop','Shop Game','Display') THEN 'Shop Ads'
            WHEN pricing_type IN (1, 2) THEN 'Manual'
            WHEN pricing_type IN (3, 4) THEN 'Simple'
            WHEN pricing_type IN (11) THEN 'Target ROI2'
            WHEN pricing_type IN (9, 10, 14) THEN 'Live Ads'
            ELSE 'Others'
        END AS main_product_type
        ,SUM(CASE WHEN seller_type_1p NOT IN ('Local SCS','SCS','Lovito')
                  THEN net_ads_rev_usd END) AS net_ads_rev_excl_1p
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'local' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
) t1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region
        ,SUM(DISTINCT platform_gmv) AS platform_gmv
    FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'local' GROUP BY 1, 2
) t2 ON t1.grass_date = t2.grass_date AND t1.grass_region = t2.grass_region
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

```sql
-- OKR Take Rate (排除 1P 卖家和 SIP)
okr_take_rate = SUM(IF(seller_type_1p NOT IN ('Lovito','SCS','Local SCS'),
                    net_ads_rev_excl_sip_usd_1d, 0))
              / SUM(DISTINCT platform_gmv_excl_testorder)

-- Gross Take Rate
gross_take_rate = SUM(ads_rev_usd) / SUM(DISTINCT platform_gmv_excl_testorder)

-- Take Rate (扣 ROI3 voucher)
take_rate = (net_ads_rev - roi3_voucher_cost) / platform_gmv

-- VAT 扣减后广告收入 (生产逻辑中使用)
ads_rev_usd = raw_ads_rev_usd / (1 + tax_rate)

-- 净收入（排除 SIP）
net_ads_rev_excl_sip = net_ads_revenue_usd_1d - sip_free_credit_revenue_usd_1d

-- 效率指标
cpm = SUM(ads_rev_usd) / SUM(ads_imp) * 1000
cpc = SUM(ads_rev_usd) / SUM(ads_click)
ctr = SUM(ads_click) / SUM(ads_imp)
cr  = SUM(ads_order) / SUM(ads_click)
roi = SUM(ads_gmv_usd) / SUM(ads_rev_usd)
ad_load = SUM(ads_imp) / SUM(DISTINCT entry_point_imp)
ep_traffic_ratio = SUM(DISTINCT entry_point_imp) / SUM(DISTINCT platform_imp)

-- Ads Voucher 广告商承担部分 (生产逻辑中使用)
ads_voucher_ads_part_amt_usd = ads_voucher_amt_usd * (1 - COALESCE(voucher_cofund_ratio, 1))

-- Take Rate (扣 ROI3 voucher 后净 take rate)
adjusted_take_rate = (net_ads_rev - roi3_voucher_cost) / platform_gmv

-- Target ROI2 出价达成率 (from target2_perf_report)
achive_ratio = SUM(achive_rev_1d) / (SUM(over_bid_rev_1d) + SUM(achive_rev_1d) + SUM(under_rev_1d))

-- 注意: platform_gmv / entry_point_imp / platform_imp 是非累加字段
--       跨 entry_point/pricing_type 聚合必须用 SUM(DISTINCT ...)
-- 注意: ads_voucher_omni_platform_nmv_cost_usd 全维度只有一个总值
--       跨维度聚合只能用 MAX 或 SUM(DISTINCT)，不能直接 SUM
```
